description: 5th-order Stokes waves (Fenton), H = 1 m, T = 4.5 s, d = 4.01 m (kd ~ 1, H/L ~ 0.04) propagating 100 m in NHFLOW (tutorial NHFLOW/1 extended). The simulated surface elevation must follow the generating theory (P 50) at x = 50..125 m: no loss of height, no phase drift, the crest/trough asymmetry kept.

reference.citation: Fenton, J.D. (1985) A fifth-order Stokes theory for steady waves. J. Waterway, Port, Coastal and Ocean Eng. 111(2), 216-234 (the generating theory, B 92 5, recorded with P 50)
